stpiGhBestprice.title: BestPrice Integration
stpiGhBestprice.subtitle: Product data. Clear decisions.
stpiGhBestprice.intro: Publish selected products, check data quality and calculate profitability from your own costs.
stpiGhBestprice.queued: Feed queued. The queue worker must be running.
stpiGhBestprice.buildFailed: The latest build failed. The last valid feed remains available.
stpiGhBestprice.independent: Independent extension by Stefan Pilz Ltd. No BestPrice certification.
stpiGhBestprice.currencyNote: Requires EUR, gross prices and minimum purchase quantity 1. Product prices come from the actual sales channel.
stpiGhBestprice.csvNote: Replace .xml with .csv for CSV. CSV is a merchant export; BestPrice acceptance requires confirmation.
stpiGhBestprice.mappingHelp: Sources: name, ean, manufacturerNumber, manufacturer, description, customFields.FIELD or property.GROUP_UUID. Remove empty mappings. Prices and product IDs are fixed.
stpiGhBestprice.selectFirst: First select a feed to edit.
stpiGhBestprice.qualityHelp: Local validation, not official approval. The quality score is the percentage of valid products.
stpiGhBestprice.noErrors: No stored validation messages. Check the build status.
stpiGhBestprice.pricingHelp: Preview from net costs, target margin and tax percent. No automatic price changes or different feed prices. Use a decimal point.
stpiGhBestprice.profitHelp: All amounts net in EUR. Missing costs prevent a profit figure. Enter zero only for costs that are genuinely zero.
stpiGhBestprice.plansHelp: Plans are verified by Shopware. Cancel or change plans in your Shopware account. Downgrades retain saved configurations.
stpiGhBestprice.registrationPending: The IAP catalogue is not registered yet. No paid offers are available.
stpiGhBestprice.supportHelp: Manage your BestPrice account and approval in the merchant portal. Send only redacted diagnostic codes to support.

step.account: Apply for a BestPrice merchant account.
step.select: Explicitly select sales channel, domain and products.
step.shipping: Check shipping rules in the BestPrice portal.
step.validate: Generate the feed and resolve local errors.
step.submit: Submit the feed URL to BestPrice for official validation.

field.name: Name
field.shippingFallbackConfirmed: BestPrice shipping rule reviewed and confirmed

error.request: Request failed. Check configuration and diagnostics.
